glen_wanderer.text: I came for a picnic and got the best view on Skye. Cone-shaped hills in every direction, and not a soul about. Just you, me, and a sheep with an air of superiority.
My gran said the fairies live under those hills. She said to leave a bit of bread out. I left a sausage roll. It was gone in the morning. Maybe a crow.
